rationale: Lyc. variant of ⲥⲱϫⲡ̄ 'remainder, what is left over' (Crum). Used in synonymous doublet with ⲥⲉⲡⲉ in line 22 to designate the psychic icon as the 'residue' of the New Man — what remains when the highest Mind-icon is extracted. Distinguished from accumulated ⲥⲉⲧⲧⲉ which is the same root but Lyc. orthographic variant.

Recurring verb in this kephalaion (lines 29, 31) governing 3sg.f. object (the soul/psychic icon). Habitual ϣⲁⲥ-ⲃⲁϣⲥ̄ 'she habitually pours her' fits the descent-narrative where higher icons pour the soul down through somatic registers. Possibly Lyc. variant of ⲡⲱϣ 'spread/divide' or related pouring verb. Confidence moderate.

Variant orthography of ⲫⲱⲥⲧⲏⲣ (Mani's standard title). The ⲡⲓⲛ- cluster may represent ⲡⲓ- demonstrative + ⲛ̄- linker, or be a scribal variant of ⲡⲡⲛ̄- 'our' (cf. ⲡⲡⲛ̄ⲫⲱⲥⲧⲏⲣ 'our Illuminator' in glossary). Same referent: Mani in standard Kephalaia narrative frame.

Variant/contracted form of ⲇⲓⲕⲁⲓⲟⲥ (Greek δίκαιος) with loss of initial ⲇⲓ-. Designation of the Elect/Righteous Man in Manichaean ecclesiology. In chapter heading 'Concerning the three icons in the righteous man.'

Appears three times (lines 14, 16) flanking the chapter heading. Almost certainly a scribal paragraph/section marker (possibly abbreviation of παράγραφος, or a decorative element). Not a lexical word; functions as the manuscript's structural punctuation.

Greek loanword ἐκλεκτός 'elect, chosen' with metathesis ⲩⲉⲕ for ⲗⲉⲕ. Standard Manichaean ecclesiastical-technical term for the elect grade (cf. accumulated ⲉⲕⲗⲉⲕⲧⲟⲥ ⲛ̄ⲧⲉⲗⲉⲓⲟⲥ). Documents an additional orthographic variant for this dialect.

Hapax in this corpus. Context (rays extended unto the ⲡⲡⲓⲱⲣ in cosmic-light passage) requires a structural noun for a conduit or extended channel. Possibly Lyc. for ⲡⲱⲣ 'partition' or related extension-noun. Confidence low; flagged for parallels.
Tentative reading on root ⲡⲓⲉ/ⲡⲣⲓⲉ 'shine, radiate' (in glossary). 'Gates of ϩⲡⲡⲓⲉ' = 'gates of shining-forth' = radiant gates. The ϩⲡ- prefix may be a Lyc. nominalizing element. Confidence low.
From ⲧⲁⲕⲣⲟ/ⲧⲁϫⲣⲟ 'strengthen, establish' (cf. accumulated ⲧⲁⲭⲣⲟ). With -ϩ ending possibly reflexive/passive. Used here of the rays being made firm/established within the firmaments.

From ⲱⲙⲥ̄ 'submerge, dive, sink' (cf. accumulated ⲁⲱⲙⲥ̄). The soul-icon 'sinks down' through the food into the body — the standard Manichaean motif of light entering matter through eating. Confirmed by directional ⲁⲡⲓⲧⲛⲉ 'downward' in following line.
